verdict.rationale: Motion documents some of its own event-driven automation. Its AI Workflow Builder turns SOPs into workflows, and projects advance automatically when blocking tasks are completed. Users can also set daily meeting limits that make the calendar unbookable once reached. None of this is shown to be a general user-defined rule engine where you choose a trigger and an action, and Zapier connectivity is a third-party integration, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable trigger/condition/action rule builder, a range of selectable event types and actions, depth documentation of the workflow builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
